rationale: Conservative keeps the current five relations plus protein phenotype (about 10.5k nodes / 46k edges), balanced adds pathway and strong expression with PPI thresholded (about 14k / 90k), and complete keeps everything raw with evidence classes (about 70k / 161k) at the risk of a hairball with 3.3k-degree hubs. The options differ in reachable context and asserted-row coverage, not in prediction (F-0097); balanced was adopted in CD-0013 with PPI split by evidence class, expression only at High/Medium, and pruning limited to the 634 self-loops.
subject: P-24
title: Three design options; balanced adopted
